purpose: Prevent post-outcome rescue or selective reporting when judging whether a supported recurrent RGFCA colour field is robust to measured dimensions of opportunistic observation bias.

negative_control_test.statistic: absolute opportunity-weighted Spearman correlation between the observed RGFCA field and each frozen availability surface over jointly evaluable cells
negative_control_test.matched_null: the same absolute correlation computed for each of the exact 999 species-conditioned colour-null fields with sampling geometry and the complete Monte Carlo schedule fixed
negative_control_test.p_value: (1 + number of null absolute correlations >= observed absolute correlation) / 1000
negative_control_test.multiplicity: Holm correction across the four pre-frozen negative-control surfaces

high_effort_deletion.cells_removed: the 17 cells frozen as top_decile_all_photo_effort in data/frozen/global_monte_carlo_sampling_availability_cells_v1.csv
high_effort_deletion.analysis: rerun the complete observed and 999-null RGFCA program on remaining support without changing species, photo, field, hotspot or recurrence rules except for unavailable deleted support
high_effort_deletion.pass: the same primary recurrent-field support gate passes on the reduced support

observer_unique_sensitivity.rule: at most one classifiable photograph per observer per species within a realization
observer_unique_sensitivity.analysis: rerun the complete observed and 999-null RGFCA program using only species meeting the observer-unique eligibility rule
observer_unique_sensitivity.evaluable_gate: enough eligible species remain to satisfy the already frozen realization-size and global inferential gates; otherwise report not_evaluable and do not lower them
observer_unique_sensitivity.pass_if_evaluable: the same primary recurrent-field support gate passes

overall_labels.primary_not_supported: the primary RGFCA recurrent-field gate does not pass; observation-bias sensitivities cannot rescue it
overall_labels.primary_supported_observation_robust: primary passes, high-effort deletion passes, observer-unique sensitivity is evaluable and passes, and no Holm-significant negative-control alignment is present
overall_labels.primary_supported_observation_sensitive: primary passes but at least one evaluable high-effort, observer-unique, or Holm-corrected negative-control diagnostic flags sensitivity
overall_labels.primary_supported_observation_robustness: primary passes but one or more required observation-bias diagnostics are technically or biologically not evaluable under their frozen gates

interpretation_boundary: Even the observation-robust label supports recurring flower-colour geography conditional on the public-photo frame. It does not estimate unbiased global flower-colour frequencies or recover taxa/regions with near-zero inclusion probability.
forbidden_post_outcome_changes: loosening the observer-unique eligibility rule to obtain a favourable result
using effort correction to create or rescue a primary colour zone
redefining the Holm family after seeing colour results
